issues.title: As a Release Manager I wish to be able to re-open closed issues
issues.body:
COAs and RFIs may be either `finalized` or `closed`.

On occasion, someone may wish to re-open a closed COA or RFI.  This may be because the COA needs to evolve in a later turn, or because new information come available related to an RFI.

We should support these re-open flows:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/130826821-7844e2e2-00c2-432f-9df6-a90f50d814a9.png)

Steps:
* [ ] change `coa-status-board` to include new `Re-open` button when document finalised. 
* [ ] introduce `reopen` handler, which invites player to add (optional) feedback on why document being reopeend
* [ ] change `changers.ts` to introduce new changer - which moves document to relevant new status
* [ ] update `changers.spec.ts` to test the changer
